Services

Full production consultancy, script to post.

Bring us a script or an idea. We plan the hybrid approach with you, help you capture what needs to be real, and finish the rest in our pipeline.

  1. 01

    Script & breakdown

    We break your script into shots and decide, shot by shot, what to film live, what to extend from a real take, and what to generate.

  2. 02

    Pre-production

    Shot lists, storyboards and a production plan built around the hybrid split, so budget goes where the performance is.

  3. 03

    Location capture

    We plan and supervise the capture of your real locations: 3D scans, reference photography, plates, and the facts of the day like sun position and lensing.

  4. 04

    Production support

    On-set guidance for the takes the pipeline depends on, so the footage you shoot can carry the shots you don't.

  5. 05

    Generation & post

    Keyframes and generated coverage built from your own footage and locations, conformed to match, and delivered to your edit.

  6. 06

    Delivery

    Real and generated clips handed off side by side, clearly labelled, with a record of how every generated shot was made.

Our pipeline

Every shot starts somewhere real.

  • Performances stay real

    Actors are filmed, not synthesised from a prompt. Generation extends real takes rather than inventing performances.

  • Anchored to real places

    Every generated shot starts from material captured at your actual location, so the world on screen is the one you chose.

  • Your footage stays yours

    Projects live on our own machines, not on a third-party platform. Only the reference frames a shot needs are sent to a model.

  • Transparent generation costs

    Model usage is estimated before anything is generated, so there are no surprises on the budget.

  • Every shot is accounted for

    Model, prompt, references and cost are recorded for each generated clip, so you always know what was shot and what was made.

Our tools

Built on our own software.

Behind the studio is Isora, the software we're building to run this pipeline: script breakdown, shot planning, location capture, storyboarding and generation in one place.

For now it's used in-house, on our productions and under our supervision. If you'd like to be part of its early rollout, book a call and we'll walk you through it.
